---
title: "Erdős and Icelandic engineering"
---

This is the working research book for a study of collaboration networks in
Icelandic engineering. It keeps the code, evidence, methodological decisions,
and interim findings visible while the study develops.

::: {.callout-note title="Status: working supplementary material"}
This site is a research record, not yet the final paper supplement. Results may
change as identities, publication links, and the study population are checked.
Every substantive claim should remain traceable to data and code.
:::

## Two different questions

1. **Who among Icelandic engineering researchers has the lowest genuine Erdős
   number?** This requires a documented research co-authorship path to Paul
   Erdős.
2. **Who is structurally the “Erdős of Icelandic engineering”?** This asks who
   is most central or connective within Icelandic engineering through
   co-authorship and MSc co-supervision.

The first is a shortest-path question in a global publication network. The
second is a structural question about a deliberately defined Icelandic
engineering network. They are related, but one cannot answer the other.

## Reproducibility

Skemman collection and parsing live in
[`HI-IDN/skemman-harvester`](https://github.com/HI-IDN/skemman-harvester).
This repository consumes its DuckDB output and adds only the identity and
network analysis specific to this study. Large data files remain local; cached
Quarto results allow this site to be built without publishing private or bulky
source data.

Use the GitHub links on each page to inspect its source, suggest an edit, or
open an issue about a decision or result.
